main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 5-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; minimum 500 grid cases on 100 distinct days

supporting_check.name: mean excess return, forecast > +10 minus forecast < -10

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: Every grid bar (positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window that have a close 5 bars later) with a forecast is a case. The slope is OLS with an intercept, and its t uses residual scores summed per UTC day with a G/(G-1) correction. The drift is each coin's mean grid 5-bar return over all its windows. A supporting check with an empty group fails.
